blocks.html: Forum Robinsons was recently designated as one of the official vaccination hub by the City of Mandaluyong. Dubbed as GoVax Hub, this facility spans over 1,000 square meters and is located at the 3rd level of the mall. One thousand to two thousand Filipinos in the priority groups of the LGU can be accommodated daily for their COVID 19 vaccinations. Mandaluyong Mayor Menchi Abalaos, together MMDA Chairman Benhur Abalos were present during the inaugural run.

Robinsons Malls currently hosts twenty-five (25) vaccination sites all over the Philippines. These sites: Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Galleria, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Place Novaliches, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Galleria South, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place General Trias, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, and Robinsons Place Tuguegarao in Luzon; Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Place Bacolod, Robinsons Place Antique, Robinsons North Tacloban, and Robinsons Place Ormoc in Visayas; and Robinsons Place Butuan, Robinsons Place GenSan, Robinsons Place Iligan, Robinsons Place Tagum, and Robinsons Cagayan de Oro in Mindanao.
